meta.title: Customer Service & Sales Jobs in El Paso, TX
meta.desc: Join Safe House Insurance in El Paso, Texas. Full-time and part-time, on-site Customer Service and Sales Representative positions. No insurance experience required — training provided.

hero.h1: Build Your Career With Safe House Insurance
hero.lede: We’re looking for motivated individuals to join our growing team in El Paso, Texas. Whether you’re experienced or just starting your career, we’d love to hear from you.

positions.lead: Two roles at our office in El Paso, Texas.

csr.title: Customer Service Representative
csr.p: Assist customers with insurance policies, payments, documents, and everyday service needs while delivering excellent customer service.

sales.title: Sales Representative
sales.p: Help customers explore insurance options, prepare quotes, and find coverage that meets their needs.
sales.schedule: Requires availability for variable hours, including occasional evenings, weekends and events.

c1.p: New to insurance? We’ll provide training to help you learn the industry and develop the skills needed for your role.

c2.p: Base salary, commissions and training, with plenty of room to grow your career in insurance, customer service and sales.

c3.p: Work alongside a team focused on helping customers and delivering quality service.

look.r4: Basic computer skills and willingness to learn.
look.r5: Availability to work on-site in El Paso.
look.r6: Some positions may involve occasional community events or visits to partner locations.
look.r7: Previous sales, customer service, or insurance experience is helpful but not required.
look.license: An insurance license is not required to apply. Activities that legally require a license are performed only by licensed, authorized staff.
look.background: Selected candidates will be subject to a background check and drug test before hiring, in accordance with applicable law.

apply.lead: Complete our application in five easy steps. Our hiring team will review your information and contact you for the next step.

form.position: Which position are you applying for?
form.licensed: Are you currently licensed to sell insurance?
form.licensedHint: A license is not required to apply.
form.years: How many years of insurance experience do you have?
form.background: Do you have previous sales or customer service experience?
form.computers: Are you comfortable using computers and learning new software?
form.required: English proficiency is required for these positions.
form.english: How would you rate your English proficiency?
form.spanish: How would you rate your Spanish proficiency?
form.start: When are you available to start?
form.employment: What type of employment are you seeking?
form.schedule: Are you available to work variable hours, including occasional evenings, weekends and events?
form.scheduleHint: Required for the Sales Representative position.
form.onsite: Are you available to work on-site at our El Paso office?
form.onsiteHint: All of our current positions are in person at our El Paso office.
form.events: Are you willing to participate in occasional off-site promotional events or represent Safe House Insurance at partner locations?
form.transport: Do you have reliable transportation to travel to occasional work-related events?
form.why: Why would you like to work at Safe House Insurance?
form.strengths: What strengths would you bring to our team?
form.resumeHint: PDF, DOC or DOCX, up to 5 MB.
form.fine: We use what you send only to consider you for work at Safe House Insurance. It is not shared with anyone else, and we never ask for your Social Security number or date of birth at this stage. See our Privacy Policy.

done.p: We have your application and resume. Our hiring team will review them and contact you if your qualifications match our current opportunities.

js.errEmail: Please add a valid email address.
js.errWhy: Please tell us a little more (at least a sentence).
js.errStrengths: Please tell us at least one strength.
js.errFileType: Your resume must be a PDF, DOC or DOCX file.
js.errFileSize: Your resume must be 5 MB or smaller.
